The Roughneck Skirting and Trim Puller Utility Pry Bar is a robust 11" (280mm) utility pry bar, engineered for the efficient removal of skirting boards, architraves, and decorative trim. This heavy-duty tool is ideal for refurbishment and restoration projects, providing trade professionals with precise control. Its carbon steel flat shaft is heat-treated and hardened for exceptional strength and long-term reliability. A black powder-coated finish ensures the tool is rust and corrosion-resistant, standing up to demanding worksite conditions. The integrated self-prying wedge slides behind materials with minimal surface damage, while chamfered edges improve access into tight gaps. A built-in nail remover allows for clean fastener extraction once trim is released.
b: Built for Tough Prying & Lifting Tasks
